title: decision.v1
description: FROZEN CONTRACT — do not edit without conductor approval. The coordinator's output for one incident, published on `sec.verdict` (coordinator-only publish) and, when contain is true, executed via anycast `toService:containment`. The coordinator is DETERMINISTIC — it is a vote counter, not an LLM judge: it never re-reads the incident, never reasons about the evidence, and never overrides a responder. It applies exactly one rule: contain iff >=3/5 malicious AND score >= 1.5. ACTION_SET DERIVATION: keep only actions proposed independently by >=2 responders; for each survivor take the MINIMUM ttl_s proposed and the MINIMUM (narrowest) blast_radius proposed, where narrow < moderate < broad. Two proposals are 'the same action' when action AND target match. `degraded` is true whenever the decision was reached with fewer than five assessments in hand.

x-contract.transport: Cotal channel sec.verdict (coordinator-only publish); containment via toService:containment (anycast)

decided_at_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds UTC at which the coordinator closed the vote.

verdict_counts.description: Tally of the assessments received. Sums to responders_voted.

score.description: Deterministic weighted vote score. Containment requires score >= 1.5 in addition to the >=3/5 malicious majority.

contain.description: True iff the rule fired. When true and only when true, the action_set is dispatched to toService:containment.

quorum_met.description: True when enough assessments arrived to decide at all. A decision without quorum always has contain false.

responders_voted.description: How many of the five responders returned an assessment before the deadline.

responders_no_vote.description: Canonical ids of responders that did not answer in time (timeout, crash, blocked, or not yet live).

action_set.description: Containment actions that cleared the >=2-responder bar, each already capped at the minimum ttl_s and narrowest blast_radius proposed. Empty when contain is false.

action.description: One of the ten containment kinds. Identical enum to assessment.v1.recommended_actions[].action — the two must never diverge. Enum is frozen and MUST match contracts/containment.contract.jac. Any change requires conductor approval.

target.description: Identical shape to assessment.v1.recommended_actions[].target. Carried through unchanged from the matching proposals.

ttl_s.description: MINIMUM ttl_s across all proposals of this action. Shortest wins — containment expires as early as any responder was willing to accept.

blast_radius.description: MINIMUM blast_radius across all proposals of this action, ordered narrow < moderate < broad. Narrowest wins.

proposed_by.description: Canonical ids of the responders that independently proposed this action. At least two by construction — this is the audit trail for the >=2 rule.

degraded.description: True when the decision was made with fewer than five assessments, or with any agent running blocked/mocked. A degraded decision is still valid but must be labeled as such in every artifact.

rule.description: The decision rule, emitted verbatim on every decision so the artifact is self-describing. Constant — exactly this string.
